description: This PHP source file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class 'EnforcePasswordDao' responsible for handling database operations related to enforced password requests within an OrangeHRM plugin. It includes methods for saving password requests, retrieving them by reset code, and updating their validity status.

classes.name: EnforcePasswordDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for managed enforcement of password reset requests, providing methods to save, retrieve, and update password enforcement entries.

methods.name: saveEnforcedPasswordRequest
methods.description: Persists an EnforcePasswordRequest entity and returns it.

methods.name: getEnforcedPasswordLogByResetCode
methods.description: Retrieves an EnforcePasswordRequest entity based on a reset code, including a join with the related user entity to check if the user is not deleted.

methods.name: updateEnforcedPasswordValid
methods.description: Updates the 'expired' status of an EnforcePasswordRequest for a given user ID, returning true if at least one record was updated.
